pr_body:

## Summary of the changes

Added remark which describes the warning as per https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/aspnet/core/host-and-deploy/health-checks?view=aspnetcore-7.0#require-host

## Description

Update API remarks for RoutingEndpointConventionBuilderExtensions.RequireHost to warn about host spoofing

Fixes #48818  (documentation changed)

issue_context.title: Update API remarks for RoutingEndpointConventionBuilderExtensions.RequireHost to warn about host spoofing
issue_context.body:
AspNetCore.Docs was recently updated to include a warning about port spoofing when using `RoutingEndpointConventionBuilderExtensions.RequireHost<TBuilder>`.

Issue: https://github.com/dotnet/AspNetCore.Docs/issues/29399
PR: https://github.com/dotnet/AspNetCore.Docs/pull/29463

It would be beneficial for a remark with this warning to be added to the XML docs for `RoutingEndpointConventionBuilderExtensions.RequireHost<TBuilder>` so it appears in the API documentation.
